items.q: And Fletcher Henderson, he (inaudible) another type of challenge.

ctx.x: Well, when -- while you were doing these various things, I take it that you're hearing records all this time. I mean, who sort of influenced you during this period?

Mostly, my influence come from a guy like Duke Ellington. Sounded like he had something, you know, music and creating. And Fletcher Henderson, he (inaudible) another type of challenge. He had another type of thing going. But Duke Ellington he had a tone. See, like, now, some of my features on the guitar right now is In My Solitude. And things like that. I'm doing all that on the guitar.
